name: com.shorekeyocmd/ocean-city-mcp
title: ShoreKey Ocean City, MD Direct Rentals, Parking & Coastal MCP
description: Ocean City, MD MCP: vacation rentals, stay quotes, municipal parking, NOAA surf, events & charters.

tools.name: shorekey_list_houses
tools.description:
Search published Ocean City and coastal Delaware vacation rentals, optionally filtering to open homes for fixed dates. Use this to browse inventory; do not use for single-home rules (shorekey_get_house), itemized quotes (shorekey_quote_stay), street corridors (shorekey_check_corridor_availability), or orphan gaps (shorekey_discover_unrented_specials).
Parameters: check_in and check_out must be paired (passing one fails HTTP 400); guests, side, min_street/max_street, min_bedrooms, pets_allowed, and region intersect.
Behavior: no auth, zero charge, 120 req/min/IP; unpaginated houses[] ($0 guest fee, street addresses redacted).

pets_allowed.description: When true, only include pet-friendly homes.

region.description: Optional coastal region filter (ocmd, assateague, fenwick, bethany, dewey, rehoboth, lewes, delaware).

site.description: Optional published rental company site_slug filter.

tools.name: shorekey_get_house
tools.description:
Retrieve full public listing details for one vacation home: bed layout, amenities, house rules, seasonal rate tiers, cancellation terms, insurance status, and verified reviews. Use this after shorekey_list_houses; do not use for date-specific pricing (shorekey_quote_stay) or blocked calendar dates (shorekey_get_unavailable_dates).
Parameters: house_id accepts the permanent listing ID; optional site scopes multi-company workspaces.
Behavior: no auth, zero charge, 120 req/min/IP; exact street address and keypad codes stay locked until booking confirmation; HTTP 404 unknown house_id.

tools.name: shorekey_get_unavailable_dates
tools.description:
List sorted unavailable YYYY-MM-DD calendar dates for one listed vacation home without disclosing whether nights are guest bookings or owner holds. Use this to inspect raw calendar openings on one house_id; do not use to search across homes (shorekey_list_houses) or price a stay (shorekey_quote_stay).
Parameters: omitting from defaults to today ET, and omitting to defaults to +90 days (max span 400 days; to < from fails HTTP 400).
Behavior: no auth, zero charge, 120 req/min/IP; live D1 calendar read (no cache), HTTP 404 unknown house_id.

from.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today in Ocean City.

to.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 90 days after from.

tools.name: shorekey_quote_stay
tools.description:
Compute an itemized USD-cent stay quote (nightly rates, cleaning, taxes, deposit schedule, cancellation terms) or return stay-rule conflicts and alternative dates for one home. Use this to verify exact pricing; do not use to generate the human checkout handoff (shorekey_prepare_stay_handoff) or browse homes (shorekey_list_houses).
Parameters: check_out must follow check_in; guests > max_guests or min-night/changeover conflicts return HTTP 200 with available=false and problems[].
Behavior: no auth, zero charge, 120 req/min/IP; places no hold on nights; HTTP 400 invalid dates, HTTP 404 unknown house_id.

tools.name: shorekey_prepare_stay_handoff
tools.description:
Prepare a human-approved checkout link and API contract for a specific home (guest_direct_checkout) or an island-wide stay request (stay_request_intake). Use this when ready to book or inquire; do not use for price-only checks (shorekey_quote_stay) or charters (shorekey_prepare_charter_handoff).
Parameters: supplying house_id selects guest_direct_checkout (ignoring preferred_zone/budget_max_cents), whereas omitting house_id selects stay_request_intake; age_confirmed passes age attestation.
Behavior: no auth, zero charge, 120 req/min/IP; holds no nights, charges no card, and unlocks no address; HTTP 400/404.

house_id.description: Optional listed property ID for a direct home checkout handoff. Omit for an island-wide stay request.

preferred_zone.description: Preferred Ocean City zone for island-wide stay requests.

budget_max_cents.description: Optional maximum total stay budget in USD cents for stay-request intake.

age_confirmed.description: True only when the guest confirmed they meet the home's minimum renter age; passed through to the booking request.

tools.name: shorekey_check_corridor_availability
tools.description:
Find bookable N-night stay windows across a flexible date horizon near a target Ocean City street number (0 = Inlet through 146 = Delaware line). Use this when street location and trip length are known but dates are flexible; do not use for fixed-date searches (shorekey_list_houses) or 1-6 night orphan gaps (shorekey_discover_unrented_specials).
Parameters: street anchors proximity ranking; from defaults to today ET and to defaults to +60 days (nights must fit inside from..to).
Behavior: no auth, zero charge, 120 req/min/IP; returns corridor-approximate homes[] with booking_recheck_required=true; HTTP 400 invalid range.

street.description: Ocean City street number (0 = Inlet, 146 = Delaware line).

from.description: Window start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today in Ocean City.

to.description: Window end date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 60 days after from.

tools.name: shorekey_discover_unrented_specials
tools.description:
Scan published Ocean City vacation homes over the next 3 to 60 days to surface unrented last-minute openings and 1-6 night orphan gaps trapped between stays. Use this for short flexible deal discovery; do not use for fixed-date searches (shorekey_list_houses) or street-corridor scans (shorekey_check_corridor_availability).
Parameters: include_orphan_gaps=true (default) includes windows shorter than seasonal min_nights; zone, side, and guests intersect.
Behavior: no auth, zero charge, 120 req/min/IP; computes per-person split math without holding nights or exposing street addresses.

site.description: Optional published rental company site_slug filter.

max_days_out.description: Horizon in days from today in Ocean City to scan for unrented windows.

include_orphan_gaps.description: When true (default), includes 1–6 night orphan gap windows trapped between bookings or season rules.

tools.name: shorekey_list_destinations
tools.description:
Search the Ocean City destination directory covering beach/bay access points, physical QR portals, dining/marina spotlights, and numbered street corridors (0..146). Use this to browse access points and find IDs before parking queries; do not use to inspect one known ID (shorekey_get_destination) or rank parking lots (shorekey_find_parking).
Parameters: kind, zone, street, side, and query intersect; rental_property entries expose corridor coordinates only.
Behavior: no auth, zero charge, 120 req/min/IP; returns up to limit entries (default 25, max 100) with street addresses redacted.

kind.description: Filter directory entries by destination kind.

street.description: Optional Ocean City numbered street corridor (0 = Inlet/Boardwalk through 146th St).

side.description: Optional corridor side when resolving a numbered street.

query.description: Free-text search across access point names, spotlights, street numbers, or rental titles.

limit.description: Maximum number of directory entries to return (1 to 100; defaults to 25).

site.description: Optional published rental company site_slug filter.

tools.name: shorekey_get_destination
tools.description:
Retrieve coordinates, amenities, transit stops, boat-ramp/EV metadata, and parking summary for one Ocean City destination_id or physical QR portal_id. Use this when you have an exact identifier from shorekey_list_destinations or a QR sign; do not use for keyword browsing (shorekey_list_destinations) or multi-lot parking ranking (shorekey_find_parking).
Parameters: identifier accepts either a destination_id (e.g. "oc_inlet_beach") or a portal_id ("portal_*" prefix routes automatically).
Behavior: no auth, zero charge, 120 req/min/IP; rental_property entries redact street addresses; returns HTTP 404 destination_not_found when unmatched.

identifier.description: Exact Ocean City destination_id (e.g. "oc_inlet_beach", "oc_convention_center_40th") or physical QR portal_id (e.g. "portal_oc_inlet_01").

site.description: Optional published rental company site_slug filter when resolving a company-scoped property pin.

tools.name: shorekey_find_parking
tools.description:
Rank closest Ocean City municipal parking lots, ParkMobile zones, EV/trailer lots, flood-safe lots, and West OC Park & Ride options for a target location. Use this to compare candidate lots; do not use for multi-car Beach Bus cost plans (shorekey_plan_parking) or directory browsing (shorekey_list_destinations).
Parameters: target resolves via house_id / destination_id / portal_id > lat+lon > street > query > Inlet default; water_level_ft >= 1.8 or flood_advisory=true prioritizes high-ground lots.
Behavior: no auth, zero charge, 120 req/min/IP; live stall counts are never fabricated (availability.state="unknown").

destination_id.description: Access point ID, spotlight slug, or rental house ID (e.g., oc_inlet_beach, oc_boardwalk_arch, bottom-bouncer-fishing).

destination_kind.description: Optional destination category when resolving destination_id (access_point, spotlight, rental_property, or street_corridor).

house_id.description: Published ShoreKey vacation home ID to inspect included private parking spots and closest municipal overflow lots.

street.description: Target Ocean City street number (0 = Inlet/Boardwalk through 146th St).

side.description: Optional Ocean City island side filter (ocean, bay, west_oc, or ocean_pines).

zone.description: Optional Ocean City island zone filter (boardwalk, midtown, north, west_oc, or ocean_pines).

query.description: Natural-language destination or landmark query (e.g., "Boardwalk", "Seacrets 49th St", "Northside Park").

vehicle_type.description: Filter or rank lots for standard vehicles, oversized RVs/boat trailers, or EV charging.

prefer_free.description: Rank free municipal lots and West OC Park & Ride first.

water_level_ft.description: Optional tide/water level in feet MLLW; values >= 1.8 ft trigger high-water flood-safe parking prioritization.

flood_advisory.description: Set true during coastal flood advisories to prioritize uphill flood-safe lots (West OC Park & Ride) over low-lying bayside streets.

limit.description: Maximum number of ranked parking options to return (1 to 20; defaults to 6).

site.description: Optional published rental company site_slug filter for property parking lookups.

tools.name: shorekey_plan_parking
tools.description:
Build a step-by-step Ocean City parking and transit plan comparing municipal lot fees against Free West OC Park & Ride + $4/person Ride-All-Day Beach Bus, including multi-car rental overflow and Google Maps handoffs. Use this for group/duration cost planning; do not use to list nearby lots without trip math (shorekey_find_parking).
Parameters: target resolves via house_id / destination_id / portal_id > street > query; house_id deducts included private spots before routing overflow cars.
Behavior: no auth, zero charge, 120 req/min/IP; live stall occupancy remains availability.state="unknown".

destination_id.description: Target destination ID, spotlight slug, or rental house ID.

house_id.description: Published ShoreKey house ID to compute included parking vs. overflow cars.

side.description: Optional Ocean City island side context (ocean, bay, west_oc, or ocean_pines).

zone.description: Optional Ocean City island zone context (boardwalk, midtown, north, west_oc, or ocean_pines).

vehicle_type.description: Vehicle profile for lot eligibility: standard (default), oversized_rv_trailer, or ev.

prefer_free.description: When true, prioritizes free municipal lots and West OC Park & Ride over paid lots (defaults to false).

water_level_ft.description: Optional tide/water level in feet MLLW; values >= 1.8 ft trigger flood-safe high-ground parking ranking.

flood_advisory.description: When true, prioritizes uphill flood-safe lots (West OC Park & Ride) over low-lying bayside streets (defaults to false).

party_size.description: Total travelers in the group (used to compare $4/person Beach Bus fare against paid municipal parking).

cars_count.description: Number of vehicles in the party.

site.description: Optional published rental company site_slug filter for property overflow calculations.

tools.name: shorekey_get_coastal_conditions
tools.description:
Read live Ocean City coastal telemetry: NOAA Station 8570283 water/tide readings, NWS Marine Zone ANZ550 forecast, Beach Patrol surf/guard status, boardwalk/inlet camera streams, and OC Radio status. Use this for real-time surf, tide, and weather state; do not use for festival dates (shorekey_list_events) or flood-safe parking ranking (shorekey_find_parking).
Parameters: section="all" returns every telemetry block, or filter to weather, beach, marine, radio, or hud.
Behavior: no auth, zero charge, 120 req/min/IP; upstream NOAA/NWS feeds cache 2-5 min and degrade per-section to null.

tools.name: shorekey_list_events
tools.description:
List Ocean City annual festivals (Springfest, OC Air Show, White Marlin Open, Oceans Calling, Country Calling, Sunfest, Winterfest) and live municipal calendar events. Use this for event dates and venues; do not use for live surf/weather telemetry (shorekey_get_coastal_conditions) or charter schedules (shorekey_check_charter_availability).
Parameters: month matches month or season names case-insensitively and intersects with query keyword filtering when both are set.
Behavior: no auth, zero charge, 120 req/min/IP; returns unpaginated events[] plus major_annual_events[] (cached 5 min).

query.description: Optional keyword search across event names, locations, and descriptions.

tools.name: shorekey_check_charter_availability
tools.description:
Check departure windows (morning 8:00 AM, midday 12:00 PM, afternoon 3:30 PM), 1-hour turnaround buffers, vessel specs, and private trip packages ($500-$850) for Ocean City fishing charters. Use this to inspect open slots and package_id values; do not use to prepare the booking checkout handoff (shorekey_prepare_charter_handoff).
Parameters: slug defaults to "bottom-bouncer-fishing" (alias "bottom-bouncer"); omitting date defaults to today ET.
Behavior: no auth, zero charge, 120 req/min/IP; live D1 charter calendar check; HTTP 404 unknown slug, HTTP 400 invalid date.

date.description: Target charter date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today in Ocean City.

tools.name: shorekey_prepare_charter_handoff
tools.description:
Prepare a human-approved fishing charter checkout URL and API submission contract after verifying window availability and angler capacity. Use this once package_id, trip_date, and window_slot are chosen via shorekey_check_charter_availability; do not use for vacation home stays (shorekey_prepare_stay_handoff).
Parameters: party_size clamps to package max_guests (max 4 on ocean trolling/bottom trips, max 5 on bay/shark trips); omitting trip_date defaults to +3 days ET.
Behavior: no auth, zero charge, 120 req/min/IP; holds no boat slot and captures no payment; HTTP 400/404.

package_id.description: Charter package ID (e.g. pkg-3hr-bay-adventure, pkg-3hr-ocean-shark, pkg-4hr-bay-ray-flounder, pkg-4hr-ocean-shark, pkg-4hr-ocean-trolling-bottom, pkg-5hr-fall-drum-shark, pkg-6hr-fall-troll-drum-shark).

party_size.description: Number of anglers (max 4 for trolling/bottom, max 5 for all other trips).
